name: Kiko's Place-The Seafood King
notes: 5 photos, all menu boards. Photos 1-3 are the same food-truck board (Tacos/Quesadilla/Burritos + Ceviches) at older, higher prices. Photo 5 is a full 'New location, 1170 W Morena Blvd' flyer matching this restaurant's address, repeating the same items at current (lower) prices plus extra sections (Kikocteles, Appetizers, Soups, Clamatos, Sides) not on the truck board; used photo 5 as the primary/current source and skipped the duplicate older prices. Photo 4 (and the specials box in photo 2) list day-of-week promo deals ('Krazy Friday $20', '$2 off any cocktail') that duplicate items already listed or are unpriced promos, so those were skipped. Taco-format items are two-tier priced (taco / burrito-or-quesadilla); only the taco price is recorded, and each dish's printed description covers the other size where relevant.
